initial_damage_zero.note: Starter crack bonds omitted from neighborhood; initial Damage is zero, not the precrack length.

crack_extension_indicator.criterion: contiguous midplane bins with >= 50% broken crossing bonds; indicator, not a crack surface

time_step_screen.note: Conservative screening; not a universal nonlocal stability proof. A separate dt/2 run checks sensitivity.

scope: Synthetic thin-layer dynamic fracture demonstration with 3D Elastic constitutive law, not plane-stress calibration, a converged 3D specimen or an experimental prediction. No contact. Only the exact reviewed profile is supported.

not_verified.experimental_accuracy: Synthetic inputs without calibration, experiment or spatial convergence.
not_verified.crack_surface: No exact crack surface exported; front is a thresholded connected bond-failure indicator.
not_verified.energy_balance: No full energy/reaction-work accounting; not verified.
not_verified.mpi: This fracture profile is qualified for one process only.
